data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.en: height, stature
short

items.zh: 朋友：大山，你和马可谁个子高？
items.py: Péngyou: Dàshān, nǐ hé Mǎkě shéi gèzi gāo?
items.en: Friend: Dashan, who is taller, you or Mark?

items.zh: 大山：马可比我高，我比马可矮一点儿。
items.py: Dàshān: Mǎkě bǐ wǒ gāo, wǒ bǐ Mǎkě ǎi yīdiǎnr.
items.en: Dashan: Mark is taller than me; I'm a little shorter than Mark.
Friend: Then who is older?

items.py: Dàshān: Wǒ bǐ Mǎkě dà liǎng suì.
items.en: Dashan: I'm two years older than Mark.

items.zh: 朋友：你们谁的汉语说得更好？
items.py: Péngyou: Nǐmen shéi de Hànyǔ shuō de gèng hǎo?
items.en: Friend: Which of you speaks Chinese better?

items.zh: 大山：马可比我说得好一些，我的汉语没有他好。
items.py: Dàshān: Mǎkě bǐ wǒ shuō de hǎo yīxiē, wǒ de Hànyǔ méiyǒu tā hǎo.
items.en: Dashan: Mark speaks a bit better than me; my Chinese isn't as good as his.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.en: history
P.E., sports
maths

items.zh: 小明：我喜欢历史课、体育课，不喜欢数学课。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ xǐhuan lìshǐ kè, tǐyù kè, bù xǐhuan shùxué kè.
items.en: Xiaoming: I like history and P.E. classes, but I don't like maths.

items.zh: 同学：为什么？数学也很有意思啊。
items.py: Tóngxué: Wèi shénme? Shùxué yě hěn yǒu yìsi a.
items.en: Classmate: Why? Maths is interesting too.

items.zh: 小明：我觉得数学比历史难多了，我听不懂。
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Wǒ juéde shùxué bǐ lìshǐ nán duō le, wǒ tīng bu dǒng.
items.en: Xiaoming: I think maths is much harder than history; I can't understand it.

items.zh: 同学：别担心，我可以帮你。
items.py: Tóngxué: Bié dān xīn, wǒ kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
items.en: Classmate: Don't worry, I can help you.

items.zh: 小明：好啊，我们每天学多长时间？
items.py: Xiǎomíng: Hǎo a, wǒmen měi tiān xué duō cháng shíjiān?
items.en: Xiaoming: Great, how long shall we study each day?
Classmate: One or two hours, I guess.

items.zh: 同事：你最近比以前来得早多了，搬家了？
items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐ zuìjìn bǐ yǐqián lái de zǎo duō le, bān jiā le?
items.en: Colleague: Lately you've been arriving much earlier than before. Did you move?

items.zh: 小丽：是啊，你不知道？我上个月就搬家了，走路二十分钟就到。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Shì a, nǐ bù zhīdào? Wǒ shàng ge yuè jiù bān jiā le, zǒu lù èrshí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
items.en: Xiaoli: Yes, didn't you know? I moved last month. It's only a twenty-minute walk.
Colleague: That's very convenient.

items.zh: 小丽：我还打算买辆自行车，骑车七八分钟就能到。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ hái dǎsuàn mǎi liàng zìxíngchē, qí chē qī-bā fēnzhōng jiù néng dào.
items.en: Xiaoli: I'm also planning to buy a bike; by bike I can get here in seven or eight minutes.

items.py: Tóngshì: Nǐ bù shì yǒu yī liàng ma?
items.en: Colleague: Don't you already have one?

items.zh: 小丽：那辆太旧了，要换一辆，很便宜，两三百块钱。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Nà liàng tài jiù le, yào huàn yī liàng, hěn piányi, liǎng-sān bǎi kuài qián.
items.en: Xiaoli: That one is too old, I want to replace it. It's cheap, two or three hundred yuan.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在看房子 — Seeing an apartment

items.en: place
intermediary, agent
main
environment
nearby, vicinity

items.zh: 大山：这两个地方的房子一样吗？
items.py: Dàshān: Zhè liǎng ge dìfang de fángzi yīyàng ma?
items.en: Dashan: Are the apartments in these two places the same?

items.zh: 中介：不一样。您看，学校外边的房子比学校里边的大一些。
items.py: Zhōngjiè: Bù yīyàng. Nín kàn, xuéxiào wàibian de fángzi bǐ xuéxiào lǐbian de dà yīxiē.
items.en: Agent: No. Look, the apartment outside the school is a bit bigger than the one inside.

items.zh: 大山：大小没关系，主要是环境，哪个更安静？
items.py: Dàshān: Dàxiǎo méi guānxi, zhǔyào shì huánjìng, nǎge gèng ānjìng?
items.en: Dashan: Size doesn't matter; the main thing is the environment. Which one is quieter?

items.zh: 中介：学校里边的没有学校外边的那么安静。
items.py: Zhōngjiè: Xuéxiào lǐbian de méiyǒu xuéxiào wàibian de nàme ānjìng.
items.en: Agent: The one inside the school isn't as quiet as the one outside.
Dashan: Which one is a bit more convenient?

items.zh: 中介：学校里边比学校外边方便，附近有三四个车站。
items.py: Zhōngjiè: Xuéxiào lǐbian bǐ xuéxiào wàibian fāngbiàn, fùjìn yǒu sān-sì ge chēzhàn.
items.en: Agent: Inside the school is more convenient than outside; there are three or four stops nearby.

data.topic: 文化 · Culture (中荷差异 China vs Netherlands)

items.zh: 在荷兰，说别人胖不太礼貌。
items.py: Zài Hélán, shuō biérén pàng bù tài lǐmào.
items.en: In the Netherlands, calling someone fat is not very polite.

items.zh: 中国人大多是黑头发，所以很少说头发的颜色。
items.py: Zhōngguórén dàduō shì hēi tóufa, suǒyǐ hěn shǎo shuō tóufa de yánsè.
items.en: Most Chinese have black hair, so hair colour is rarely mentioned.

items.py: Zhōngguórén xǐhuan zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ.
items.en: Chinese people like to go to bed early and get up early.

items.zh: 荷兰人周末常常十二点以后才见面。
items.py: Hélánrén zhōumò chángcháng shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu cái jiànmiàn.
items.en: Dutch people often only meet after twelve at weekends.
